versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the contributor-guide skill.
- Generates a clear and welcoming CONTRIBUTING.md to help new contributors make their first PR.
- Covers setup instructions, contribution workflow, coding standards, PR expectations, and where to get help.
- Includes specific prompts for key project info if not already provided.
- Encourages inclusive contributions (issues, docs, code, triage) and references best open-source practices.
